caseNameFull: Ford Motor Company v. John S. Chambers, as Controller of the State of California
summary: Appeal from the District Court of the United States for the Northern District of California.
attorneys: Mr. W. F. Williamson, Mr. Alfred Lucking and Mr. L. B. Robertson for appellant., Mr. U, S.. Webb and Mr. Raymond Benjamin, for appellees, submitted.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Judgment affirmed with costs upon the authority of Arkansas Building & Loan Association v. Madden, 175 U. S. 269; Boise Artesian Water Co. v. Boise City, 213 U. S. 276; Singer Sewing Machine Co. v. Benedict, 229 U. S. 481.
